experiment.lipid_label: Nile red on a subset of plates

rules: bulk cytoplasmic movement and cargo-specific lipid movement are not interchangeable
velocity is not volumetric flow without measured cross-section mean velocity and area
volumetric flow is not nutrient mass transfer without concentration
host-free internal flow is not plant-to-plant transfer
one-year persistent observation near parental spores is not a continuously tracked one-year trajectory

proposed_targets_not_results.reproduction: reproduce source-reported flow and lipid distributions before new mechanistic claims
proposed_targets_not_results.calibration: nominal 90% and 95% predictive interval coverage on held-out plates and time blocks
proposed_targets_not_results.separation: zero silent pooling between bulk-cytoplasm and fluorescent-cargo tracer types
proposed_targets_not_results.generalization: report each of the two strains separately; no universal AMF claim

claim_ceiling: Host-free flow and cargo-specific observations for two R. irregularis strains under the named in-vitro conditions only.
